description: Use this when you need one case in full: where it stands and what it is waiting on. Input: the case `id`. Returns its facts, deadlines, documents and, for a live case, the attorney once recorded. Do not use this to find a case whose id you do not have (use evictions_list_cases) or for its history (use evictions_get_case_events). The result is the case, with `state` and `nextAction` (who it is waiting on and for what). Needs the person’s account: sign-in or an API key.

id.description: The case id (case_...), as returned by evictions_create_case or evictions_list_cases.

name: evictions_get_case
title: Get a case
